target: game.js, the capstone build served at index.html

findings.summary: The robot cited a direction the dog never favoured. The line reads "Target favored left nine of twenty recorded moves." while the dominant direction was right at 100 percent.
findings.repro: move right nine times from the start tile
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 4, the read reports what the Nemesis measured

findings.summary: Stamina went below zero before the round ended, reaching -1, in 142 of 300 runs. The HUD can show a negative number.
findings.repro: random legal inputs until the adjacency drain overshoots

findings.summary: Pressing into a wall is a complete no-op: no round, no stamina, and the robot does not move. A player who does not realise a move was rejected sees a frozen game and no feedback.
findings.repro: hold the up arrow at the top edge; nothing on screen changes
